sections.title: Two people looking in different directions
sections.bodyMarkdown:
The sun occupies the top of the picture. Beneath it, a winged figure spreads red wings above the clouds, palms turned outward. Below, a woman and a man stand naked with their arms slightly open. The man turns his face toward the woman, who looks upward. A pointed mountain stands between them, and grass stretches beneath their feet.

Behind the woman is a fruit-bearing tree with a serpent wound around its trunk. The tree behind the man has flame-like branches. Notice their different directions of gaze, the two different trees, and the layers of space formed by cloud and mountain. Nakedness may suggest openness and vulnerability to a modern reader. That is an interpretation developed from the image, not evidence of the figures’ psychological states.

[View the RWS image examined for this article](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RWS_Tarot_06_Lovers.jpg)

Choosing a relationship or collaboration also means choosing how to treat the other person and what responsibilities to share. sections.title: Everyday examples
sections.bodyMarkdown:
### A relationship is ready for a next step

Talk about the pace of the relationship, boundaries, and expectations alongside your affection. A serious choice gives the other person enough information and room to respond or decline.

### Finding a collaborator

Discuss quality, the distribution of benefits, and how you would handle disagreement. Getting along is valuable; working together also requires compatible values and practices.

### Choosing between two opportunities

articleMarkdown:
# The Lovers — Let attraction become a shared choice

VI · The Lovers · Major Arcana · RWS

**Keywords:** Attraction · Openness · Choice

**Upright at a glance:** Attraction is present, along with a willingness to choose the connection.
**Reversed at a glance:** There may be feelings, but important choices and expectations remain unclear.

The two people on the Lovers stand on the same patch of grass without holding hands. There is still space between them, and a winged figure opens its arms above. A relationship is pictured; how to move toward one another remains a human task.

## Two people looking in different directions

The sun occupies the top of the picture. Beneath it, a winged figure spreads red wings above the clouds, palms turned outward. Below, a woman and a man stand naked with their arms slightly open. The man turns his face toward the woman, who looks upward. A pointed mountain stands between them, and grass stretches beneath their feet.

Behind the woman is a fruit-bearing tree with a serpent wound around its trunk. The tree behind the man has flame-like branches. Notice their different directions of gaze, the two different trees, and the layers of space formed by cloud and mountain. Nakedness may suggest openness and vulnerability to a modern reader. That is an interpretation developed from the image, not evidence of the figures’ psychological states.

[View the RWS image examined for this article](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RWS_Tarot_06_Lovers.jpg)

## How Waite reworked the Lovers’ imagery

Waite explicitly compares the pair to Adam and Eve in Eden and identifies the Tree of Life and the Tree of Knowledge. He calls this an image of human love and rejects reducing the new design to the older image of a man choosing between virtue and vice.

This article therefore keeps love and connection at the centre, while using “choice” as a modern reflective theme. Choosing a relationship or collaboration also means choosing how to treat the other person and what responsibilities to share. That extension should remain distinct from Waite’s historical explanation.

[Read Waite’s original English discussion](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktar06.htm)

## Reading it upright

Upright, the Lovers can explore more than whether attraction exists. Can feelings become actions that both people willingly recognize as part of their relationship? Have they expressed needs, heard their differences, and chosen a direction together? Attraction brings people closer; repeated choices give a relationship its shape.

Outside romance, the card can help you ask whether a choice fits your values. Is the result you want worth the responsibilities that come with it? Finding agreement requires genuine discussion, not identical views on everything.

## Reading it reversed

Here, the reversal draws attention to differences that have not been made explicit. One person may assume a relationship has reached a new stage while the other has made no such decision. Or someone may voice a value yet consistently give it last place in their plans.

Establish what each person actually means before deciding whether an adjustment is possible. Differences can open important conversations. The card cannot prove infidelity, predict an inevitable breakup, or make a commitment for either person.

## Everyday examples

### A relationship is ready for a next step

Talk about the pace of the relationship, boundaries, and expectations alongside your affection. A serious choice gives the other person enough information and room to respond or decline.

### Finding a collaborator

Discuss quality, the distribution of benefits, and how you would handle disagreement. Getting along is valuable; working together also requires compatible values and practices.

### Choosing between two opportunities

Write down what each offers you and what each asks you to give up. Do not hand the choice entirely to other people’s approval, or ask a card to decide the consequences for you.

## A short exercise

Choose a current decision and complete: “I want to move toward this because…”, “I am willing to take responsibility for…”, and “I still need to clarify with the people involved…”. Take the final sentence into a real conversation.

## A common misreading

The Lovers does not announce that your destined partner has arrived. Nor can this image dictate the genders of people in a loving relationship. This article focuses on mutual respect, openness, and willing participation.

## Artwork and English-language sources

- [Pamela Colman Smith, The Lovers, RWS Pam-A](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:RWS_Tarot_06_Lovers.jpg)
- [A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, Part II, VI. The Lovers (1911 transcription)](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pktar06.htm)
- [A. E. Waite, The Pictorial Key to the Tarot, Part III §3, The Greater Arcana and Their Divinatory Meanings (1911 transcription)](https://original.sacred-texts.com/tarot/pkt/pkt0303.htm)

Each image was individually inspected. The English source is the transcription labelled 1911; the artwork is the Pam-A scan identified on Commons. Sources checked: 2026-10-07.

The upright and reversed interpretations, examples, and exercises are original material for reflection, not line-by-line translations of old divinatory lists. Tarot cannot establish future events, another person’s thoughts, or a health condition.

sourceRecord.title: 恋人 让吸引走向彼此认同
sourceRecord.uprightQuickTake: 彼此吸引，也愿意认真选择这段连接
sourceRecord.reversedQuickTake: 有感觉却没对齐，重要的选择还没说清
sourceRecord.hook: 恋人的两个人站在同一片草地上，却没有牵手。他们之间仍有空间，上方还有一位张开双臂的有翼人物。关系在画里出现了，怎样走近彼此，仍留给人去完成。
imageReading: 太阳占据画面顶部，有翼人物从云层上方展开红色翅膀，双掌朝外。下方一女一男赤身站立，手臂略向两侧打开。男子把脸转向女子，女子抬头望向上方。两人之间是一座尖起的山，草地在脚下铺开。
女子身后是结着果实的树，蛇缠绕在树干上；男子身后的树枝呈火焰般形状。这里可以观察到不同的观看方向、两棵不同的树，以及被云和山分层的空间。裸体可以让今天的读者想到坦诚与暴露感，但那是由图像发展出的解释，不能据此猜测人物的心理。
tradition: Waite 明确把两个人比作伊甸园中的亚当与夏娃，分别提到生命树和知识树。他把此牌称为人类之爱的图像，并反对把新版画面简化为一个男人在美德与恶德之间选择的旧式说法。
因此，本篇保留爱与连接这个核心，再把“选择”作为现代反思角度：当你选择一段关系或合作，也在选择如何对待对方、愿意共同承担什么。这个延伸与 Waite 的历史说明需要分开看。
uprightMeaning: 正位不只适合讨论“有没有感觉”，也适合看感觉是否能成为彼此认同的行动。双方有没有表达需要、听见差异，并愿意参与同一个方向？吸引使人靠近，持续的选择让关系有具体形状。
放到非爱情问题中，也可以检查选择与价值是否一致。你想得到的成果，是否值得你承担随之而来的责任？这里的“对齐”需要真实协商，不要求两个人在所有事情上都一样。
reversedMeaning: 本篇把逆位用来观察未说清的差异：有人默认关系已经进入下一阶段，另一人却还没有同样决定；或嘴上认同一种价值，实际安排却总把它排到最后。
先确认彼此真实的意思，再判断能否调整。分歧可以带来重要对话，但牌本身无法证明不忠、注定分手，也不能替任何一方作出承诺。

situations.title: 一段关系准备向前走
situations.text: 除了表达喜欢，也谈谈相处节奏、边界与双方期待。所谓认真选择，需要对方有知情、回应和拒绝的空间。

situations.title: 寻找合作伙伴
situations.text: 先讨论质量、利益分配与遇到分歧时的处理方式。聊得投机很好，共同工作还需要价值与做法能够衔接。

situations.title: 在两个机会之间犹豫
situations.text: 分别写下它们满足了你什么，又要求你放弃什么。不要把决定完全交给他人的赞许，也不要让一张牌替你决定后果。

sourceRecord.practice: 写出一件你正在选择的事，补完：“我想靠近它，因为……”“我愿意承担……”“我还需要和相关的人确认……”。把最后一句带进真实对话。
sourceRecord.commonMisread: 恋人不是“命中注定的那个人已经出现”。这幅画也不能规定爱情必须符合某种性别组合；本篇关注的是相互尊重、坦诚与自愿参与。
sourceRecord.sourceClaim: 伊甸园、两棵树、蛇、有翼人物与人类之爱；Waite反对旧图善恶二选一简化。价值选择与相互同意为现代原创教学。
sourceRecord.readingApproach: 图像细读、Waite历史解释与原创现代反思分别标示；正逆位是学习与自我反思提示，不用来确认未来、健康或他人隐秘行为。
sourceRecord.reverseMethod: 当代反思式读法，依据正位主题的受阻、失衡或尚待整合展开；不是对Waite旧逆位词条逐项翻译。
